extracted.name: Pesto
extracted.description: This basic pesto is a no-fail recipe made with aromatic basil, olive oil, garlic, Parmesan, pine nuts, and parsley. Great as a dip, spread, or sauce.
instruction_lines: Combine basil, Parmesan cheese, olive oil, pine nuts, and garlic in the bowl of a food processor or blender. Blend to a smooth paste. Add lemon juice, if desired, and quickly pulse to combine.
